newsitem.title: USA: A.M. Best downgrades Home State Holdings.
newsitem.headline: A.M. Best downgrades Home State Holdings.

text.p: Insurance rating firm A.M. Best Co said it has lowered the "C" (Weak) ratings of Home State Holdings Inc's two property/casualty groups to "D" (Poor).

The downgrade was made because the Home State New York Pool and Home State National Pool units are extremely vulnerable to unfavorable changes in underwriting and to potential regulatory responses, A.M. Best said.
Both of those units have fallen below certain regulatory standards for capitalization, A.M. Best said.
